events.textEn: Israel signed disengagement agreements with Egypt and Syria.
events.textHe: ישראל חתמה על הסכמי הפרדת כוחות עם מצרים ועם סוריה.

cites.quote: the disengagement agreements were signed with Egypt and Syria in 1974
Separation-of-forces agreement signed with Egypt
Disengagement agreement is signed with Syria
חתמה על הסכם … הפרדת הכוחות עם מצרים ב־18 בינואר 1974
ביום ו׳, י׳ בסיון תשל״ד — 31 במאי 1974, נחתם בז׳נבה הסכם הפרדת הכוחות בין סוריה לישראל

notes: Both agreements were signed under Golda Meir: Egypt on 18 January 1974 (before the eighth Knesset opened on 21 January), Syria on 31 May 1974 (before Rabin’s government took office on 3 June). The row remains year-level.

equates Zionism with racism

notes: MFA timeline misnumbers the resolution as 3375; the number and adoption date follow the resolution itself. The text describes the Assembly’s determination, not an editorial endorsement.
